observations.title: Use Ceraunus's three special actions
observations.player_action: Use the addon controls numbered 1, 2 or 3 while wielding Ceraunus with sufficient skill points.
observations.outcome: The documented actions throw it, project a fan-shaped wave, or leap with lightning and waves; costs increase across those actions.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: The listed 1/2/3 actions refer to addon skill controls, not permission to replace hotbar keys. Detect native successful ability/resource consumption; owning a Cataclysm weapon is insufficient. Resolve overlap with epicfight_cataclysm before implementation.
